questions.name: time_of_day
questions.definition: The light in the photograph, from what is visible, not from the clock.

options.label: golden hour
options.description: Warm low-angle sunlight and long shadows.

options.label: daylight
options.description: Bright daytime light, sun high enough that the scene is not golden or blue.

options.label: blue hour
options.description: Cool dim light just before sunrise or after sunset.

options.label: night
options.description: Dark scene lit by night, streetlights, or indoor lamps after dark.

options.label: indoor
options.description: The light is from an interior, with no clear outdoor sky.

options.label: other / none of these
options.description: None of the lighting labels fit.

questions.name: subject_type
questions.definition: The main thing the frame is about.

options.label: people
options.description: A person is the subject.

options.label: food
options.description: Food or a drink is the subject.

options.label: places
options.description: A place or view is the subject.

options.label: nature
options.description: Plants, weather, or natural land is the subject.

options.label: architecture
options.description: A building or built structure is the subject.

options.label: products
options.description: A product made to be shown is the subject.

options.label: objects
options.description: A physical object is the subject.

options.label: animals
options.description: An animal is the subject.

options.label: abstract
options.description: Color, texture, or shape is the subject, without a clear thing.

options.label: other / none of these
options.description: None of the subject labels fit.

questions.name: people
questions.definition: How many people are visible, in coarse buckets.

options.label: none
options.description: No person is visible.

options.label: one person
options.description: Exactly one person is visible.

options.label: several
options.description: More than one person is visible.

questions.name: setting
questions.definition: Where the photograph was made.

options.label: indoor
options.description: Inside a room or covered interior.

options.label: outdoor
options.description: Outside, and not specifically urban or wild.

options.label: urban
options.description: A city street, building front, or built-up outdoor place.

options.label: nature
options.description: A wild or planted outdoor place with little built structure.

options.label: studio
options.description: A controlled backdrop or studio setup.

options.label: other / none of these
options.description: None of the setting labels fit.

questions.name: photo_style
questions.definition: How the photograph is framed.

options.label: candid
options.description: The subject does not look posed for the camera.

options.label: posed
options.description: The subject is arranged for the camera.

options.label: flat lay
options.description: Objects are arranged on a surface and shot from above.

options.label: close-up
options.description: The frame is filled by a small area of the subject.

options.label: wide shot
options.description: The frame shows a wide view of a place or group.

options.label: aerial
options.description: The camera is clearly above the subject, looking down from height.

options.label: silhouette
options.description: The subject is dark against a brighter background.

options.label: other / none of these
options.description: None of the framing labels fit.

questions.name: mood cozy
questions.definition: The photograph feels cozy: close, warm, and sheltered.

questions.name: mood energetic
questions.definition: The photograph feels energetic: motion, high contrast, or a bright active scene.

questions.name: mood calm
questions.definition: The photograph feels calm: still, quiet, and uncluttered.

questions.name: mood moody
questions.definition: The photograph feels moody: dim light and heavy shadow.

questions.name: mood playful
questions.definition: The photograph feels playful: bright color or a lighthearted subject.

questions.name: mood dreamy
questions.definition: The photograph feels dreamy: soft focus, haze, or pastel light.

questions.name: mood bold
questions.definition: The photograph feels bold: strong color, hard contrast, or a graphic shape.

questions.name: mood nostalgic
questions.definition: The photograph feels nostalgic: faded color or an older print look.

questions.name: mood luxe
questions.definition: The photograph feels luxe: polished materials, careful light, and little clutter.

questions.name: mood raw
questions.definition: The photograph feels raw: harsh light, grain, or an unpolished moment.

questions.name: aesthetic minimal
questions.definition: Few objects, large empty areas, and a restrained palette.

questions.name: aesthetic vintage
questions.definition: Colors and contrast look like an older print or aged paper.

questions.name: aesthetic film
questions.definition: Grainy, faded colors, soft contrast, like a 35mm film photo.

questions.name: aesthetic y2k
questions.definition: Glossy early-2000s color, flash, or chrome details.

questions.name: aesthetic editorial
questions.definition: Styled like a magazine photograph, with deliberate pose and light.

questions.name: aesthetic street
questions.definition: A public street moment, shot as it happened.

questions.name: aesthetic cinematic
questions.definition: Wide contrast and color that looks like a film still.

questions.name: aesthetic clean
questions.definition: Even light, tidy frame, and no visible clutter.

questions.name: aesthetic grainy
questions.definition: Visible grain or noise across the frame.

questions.name: aesthetic maximalist
questions.definition: The frame is packed with color, pattern, or objects.

questions.name: season summer
questions.definition: Bright sun, warm weather, or summer clothes and plants.

questions.name: season rainy
questions.definition: Rain, wet ground, or umbrellas are visible.

questions.name: season festive
questions.definition: Decorations or a celebration are visible.

questions.name: season holiday
questions.definition: A holiday marker such as lights, a tree, or a feast is visible.

questions.name: season cold
questions.definition: Snow, frost, heavy coats, or bare winter trees are visible.

questions.name: season tropical
questions.definition: Palm trees, turquoise water, or dense tropical plants are visible.

questions.name: has_text
questions.definition: Letters or numbers are visible in the photograph.

questions.name: subject_visible
questions.definition: A clear main subject is visible, rather than an empty texture or frame.

questions.name: calm to energetic
questions.definition: Where the photograph sits between calm and energetic.

questions.name: playful to serious
questions.definition: Where the photograph sits between playful and serious.

questions.name: rustic to polished
questions.definition: Where the photograph sits between rustic and polished.
